EmailTemplate.description: Auto acknowledgement email for Specific Needs form on Qantas.com
EmailTemplate.name: QCC Specific Needs Acknowledgement
EmailTemplate.subject: We've received your Specific Needs Request - {{{Case.CaseNumber}}}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {{{Case.First_Name__c}}},
Thank you for submitting an Accessibility, Medical and Inclusion Request. We understand how important these requests are for safe and supportive travel, and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
Your case number is: {{{Case.CaseNumber}}}
Our Customer Specific Needs team will review your request and once processed, will contact you on your preferred contact method.
If you need further information to follow up on the status of your request, please respond directly to this email.
Imminent Travel Requirements
What timeframe classifies as an imminent travel request? - Request submitted 2 daysbefore intended travel for deaf or hearing impaired passengers, blind or vision impaired passengers, hidden disabilities, or child, car seats - Request submitted 14 daysbefore intended travel for service dogs - Request submitted 5 daysbefore intended travel for medical clearances and CPAP - Request submitted 7 daysbefore intended travel for stretchers
For travel that is submittedwithin the above timeframesand requires attention for imminent travel, please call us so we can expedite the processing of your request.
- The Specific Needs team is available between 6am and 10pm (AEST), Monday to Sunday on 1800 177 474 (within Australia) or +61 2 9123 7471 (outside Australia). - Please select option 3 and reference your case number provided above.
Kind regards,
{{{Sender.FirstName}}}
Qantas Customer Specific Needs
